Author: ViewInFFXIV
Name: ViewInFFXIV
Punchline: Put WatchTogether on a wall in your house.
Description:
Hosts WatchTogether.watch in a helper process and draws the video on a 16:9 screen in FFXIV housing. Chat stays in /say.

The install zip includes the local WebView2 helper — no separate server setup. Open with /viewin. Requires WebView2 Runtime (usually already installed via Edge).
